verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no user-configurable automation feature in Dropbox that runs autonomously in the background. Webhooks, the Files API and the SDKs are developer building blocks a programmer could use to build automations. Background sync and Dropbox Sign's automatic saving of signed documents are related but different features, so none of this counts as the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
